SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS succeeded_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'TIMEOUT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('SUBMITTING', 'RUNNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_progress_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN image_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_images, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(SUM(image_cost), 0) AS total_image_cost, COALESCE(SUM(llm_cost), 0) AS total_llm_cost, AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN total_cost END) AS avg_cost, AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN total_elapsed_ms END) AS avg_elapsed_ms FROM t_image_task
